svgPlanScope: Import line, polyline, polygon and plain rectangle coordinates. Set millimetres for each SVG user unit: viewport width, height and viewBox no set this scale. Group names become architecture layers. We report unsupported geometry; appearance no dey imported. For automatic mode, absolute root width/height and viewBox set the physical mapping.

boardAssignmentProtection: Remove circuit and zone assignments before you remove this board association.
circuitRouteProtection: Unassign or remove routes wey join this circuit before you remove am.
selectElectricalPlanLayer: Select electrical layer wey you fit edit
circuitLoadEntryScope: Enter active load in watts for each selected equipment. Empty means unknown; enter 0 only if load na known zero. Na user supply values; this place no calculate demand or protection size.
deviceAssignedOtherCircuit: This equipment don join another floor circuit.
protectedCircuitLayers: Show and unlock circuit, board and equipment layers before you edit this circuit.
floorRouteScope: Routes save cable, conduit or tray shape for this floor. Lines wey cross no join wires. Length na horizontal plan length; e no include rise, drop, slack or installation allowance. Overlapping routes count separately.
planRoutePoints: Route points (mm; one X,Y pair for each line)
routePointsInvalid: Enter 2–10,000 valid X,Y pairs, one for each line, within ±1,000,000 mm.
protectedRouteLayers: Show and unlock this route layer and assigned circuit layer before you edit am.
createFloorDeviceScope: Create native equipment and floor placement together. The linked schematic symbol go dey drawing page wey you select. Generic symbols no carry manufacturer ratings.
assignmentDiagramNote: Branches show circuit assignment; dem no mean conductor wiring or verified protection.
earthingDocumentationNote: Na native PE terminals and wires wey you draw dey here. E no certify continuity or installation compliance.

reportExportError: Export fail. Allow print window or try download again.
plcMappingNote: Terminal and signal assignments na documentation. Dem no create wire or run PLC code.
plcScope: Generic native interfaces and explicit I/O documentation. Check address syntax for the PLC wey you choose. Emergency-stop or interlock drawing no be certified safety function.
floorSpecialEquipmentScope: Emergency light get external battery connection. Fire-loop and data contacts stay separate; only PE point join inside. We no assume ratings, protocol, light performance or compliance.
planRiserScope: Riser use one X/Y shaft position across two floors. Vertical length use floor levels and endpoint heights; e no include slack, horizontal routes or cable quantities. E no create electrical connections.
riserNeedsFloors: Add two floors and electrical layers wey you fit edit before you create riser.
panelScope: Generic boxes use component dimensions wey get record or dimensions wey user enter. Dem no be original manufacturer CAD.
panelCoordinates: Millimetres: X go right, Y go down, Z go from back to front. Position na minimum corner; rotation swaps width and height.
panelOrbit: Drag 3D view to turn am; both views use the same native geometry.
panelDragHint: Select object for any view. Drag for front view or use move controls. Each finished move na one undo step.
panelMountingPosition: Check mounting contact and support span
panelCheckScope: Checks use solid boxes and entered clearance. Mounting checks na geometry only; rail-profile fit, service access, door travel and electrical/thermal compliance need documented rules and review.
panelExportNote: Generic cuboid layout; dimensions na mm; verify before construction.
panelInvalid: Panel change no save. Check values, references and assigned component dimensions.
panelCableDiameters: Cable outside diameters (mm; separate with comma)
panelDuctScope: Area estimate = total π × outside diameter² / 4 divided by usable area wey you enter. E no infer packing, bends, separation or installation rules.
panelThermalScope: Steady-state estimate: rise = max(0, total loss − cooling) / (U × exposed area). Enter every device loss; zero dey valid. No hot spots, airflow, transients or certified temperature limits for this model. Professional review dey required before construction.
calcScope: Choose method and enter source data. Results na estimates or checks for only the conditions wey you supply.
calcEvidenceHint: Write manufacturer, document edition, table/page and conditions; one note per line. App no independently verify these notes.
calcUnitConversionHint: When you change unit, the entered value converts. Fill every input; no hidden engineering defaults.
calcSaved: Calculation don save inside native project.
calcWarningEstimate: This result no be verified engineering design. Qualified professional must review construction and protection decisions.
calcWarningEvidence: Input sources and installation conditions na user declarations; app no independently verify them.
calcWarningCheckFailed: At least one supplied condition no meet. Review inputs and proposed equipment.
calcWarningLargeDrop: Calculated drop reach or pass supply voltage; this steady-state approximation no suit these inputs.
calcErrorUnit: Choose supported unit for this quantity.
calcErrorRange: Value dey outside this method’s allowed range or choices.
calcErrorNumeric: Calculation pass numerical limits or arithmetic no valid.
calcErrorEvidence: Add source and condition notes (8–900 characters per note; maximum 50 notes).
calcErrorPowerTriangle: Active power no fit pass apparent power.
calcErrorTemperature: Temperature correction give zero or negative resistance.
calcErrorImpedance: Supply total source impedance wey no be zero.
calcErrorMethod: Saved method version no get support. Keep the record and recalculate with current method.
calcErrorRecord: Calculation record no complete or no match this method.
calcFieldResistancePerLength: AC resistance per length at operating temperature
calcFieldReactancePerLength: Reactance per length at operating frequency
calcFieldInstallationFactor: Product of other applicable correction factors
calcFieldFixturePower: Complete fixture input power including driver
calcCheckSelectivity: Fault current below supplied selectivity limit
calcCheckBreakingCapacity: Fault current within supplied breaking capacity
calcCheckAmpacityProtection: Device rated current ≤ corrected cable ampacity
calcAssumptionOhmic: Linear DC load with constant resistance; voltage and current na magnitudes.
calcAssumptionAcDc: DC needs power factor 1. AC uses RMS voltage/current and true power factor; single-phase only.
calcAssumptionSinusoidal: Power triangle and phase angle assume sinusoidal steady state; cosφ no cover distortion.
calcAssumptionBalanced: Three-phase needs balanced loads and line-to-line RMS voltage; single-phase uses phase-to-neutral voltage.
calcAssumptionReactiveMagnitude: Result na |Q|. P and S alone no show leading or lagging direction.
calcAssumptionTruePowerFactor: λ = P/S na true power factor. E equals cosφ only for sinusoidal voltage/current.
calcAssumptionOneWayLength: Length na one-way route; formula includes return path for single-phase circuits.
calcAssumptionLagging: Voltage-drop estimate supports lagging loads with r and x ≥ 0. Use verified operating-temperature and frequency values.
calcAssumptionUserData: Supply all installation, equipment and correction data with matching sources and conditions.
calcAssumptionLinearTemperature: Linear temperature correction works only within material range. Supply α and ΔT from resistivity reference temperature.
calcAssumptionOneConductor: Resistance na for one uniform conductor; AC skin/proximity effects and joints no dey included.
calcAssumptionElectricalInput: P na electrical input power; motor shaft power needs motor calculator and explicit efficiency.
calcAssumptionLoadingLimit: User supplies allowed loading; no automatic 80% rule or trip-curve assessment.
calcAssumptionTransformer: Steady-load estimate only. Check harmonics, heating, impedance, losses, inrush and product selection separately.
calcAssumptionMotorNameplate: Use nameplate operating-point efficiency and power factor. Calculated current no replace manufacturer current data.
calcAssumptionStarting: Manufacturer/user supplies starting multiplier. Start duration, torque, voltage dip, starter behavior and protection no dey simulated.
calcAssumptionConstantPower: Active power stays constant while on; duty fraction applies across entered duration.
calcAssumptionCableLoss: Each counted conductor uses entered resistance and RMS current. Neutral needs its own suitable load model.
calcAssumptionFaultModel: Single-source balanced three-phase symmetrical RMS fault estimate with explicit total positive-sequence R, X and voltage factor. No IEC 60909 compliance claim; peak/asymmetry, earth faults and other sources no dey included.
calcAssumptionManufacturerPair: Selectivity limit must match exact device pair, settings, voltage and manufacturer table edition. Equality at limit no count.
calcAssumptionCoordinationScope: Na numerical threshold comparison only. Full overload, short-circuit and earth-fault selectivity, backup protection, trip times and other supplies remain unverified.
calcAssumptionCableCandidate: Enter candidate size and matching table ampacity for material, insulation, installation method and loaded conductors. App no invent cable table or choose standard size.
calcAssumptionCableScope: Only I_b ≤ I_n ≤ I_z gets checked. Trip current, voltage drop, thermal fault withstand, neutral harmonics, mechanical limits and disconnection time need separate verification.
calcAssumptionDemand: Apply explicit utilization and coincidence factors to one load group. Coincidence na 0–1; no be reciprocal diversity factor. No local factors assumed.
calcAssumptionBattery: Constant nominal voltage and load with explicit usable capacity and efficiency. Manufacturer must assess temperature, ageing, Peukert/rate effects, inverter standby, BMS cutoffs and discharge curves.
calcAssumptionUps: Both W and VA ratings must meet estimate. Battery covers entered load and runtime; sizing multiplier applies to UPS ratings only. Crest factor, inrush and runtime curves remain unverified.
calcAssumptionGenerator: Steady-load/VA envelope only. Enter whole coincident starting apparent load including running loads. Separate kW/kVA ratings, motor transients, voltage/frequency dips and manufacturer sizing still required.
calcAssumptionLighting: Fixture input includes driver/ballast losses. This estimates electrical load and energy; illuminance, emergency-lighting compliance and inrush no dey included.
calcAssumptionEarthRing: Approximate buried ring touching homogeneous soil. Measure representative soil resistivity. No rods, grids, layered soil, touch/step voltage or automatic compliance check; field testing required.
